title: prunus sachalinensis var. compta
intro: Prunus sachalinensis var. compta, commonly known as the Japanese plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential to provide relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Prunus sachalinensis var. compta include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
